units.source_text: 且说明石浦上，年年每届秋季，海风异常凄厉。

en.t: Now, at Akashi Bay, whenever autumn came each year, the sea wind was extraordinarily bleak and fierce.

units.source_text: 源氏公子独处孤眠，痛感寂寥之苦，便时时向明石道人催促：“好歹想个办法，赚你家小姐到这里来吧。”

en.t: Prince Genji, sleeping alone in solitude and keenly feeling the pain of loneliness, often urged the Akashi monk, "Do whatever you can to find some way to bring your daughter here."
He himself would not go to seek a meeting with her.

units.source_text: 而明石姬亦决不愿自动来访。

en.t: And the Lady of Akashi was equally determined not to come visiting of her own accord.

units.source_text: 她想：“身份极卑的乡下姑娘，才会受暂时下乡的京都男子的诱惑，而轻率地委身求爱。

en.t: She thought, "Only a country girl of the very lowest standing would be tempted by a Kyoto gentleman temporarily staying in the provinces and rashly give herself to him in love.
How could I possibly be compared with such women?

units.source_text: 像源氏公子那样的人，本来不把我们这种人看在眼里。

en.t: A man like Prince Genji would never normally take any notice of people like us.

units.source_text: 我若与他苟合，将来定多痛苦。

en.t: If I were to enter into a careless affair with him, I would surely suffer greatly in the future.

units.source_text: 父母抱着高不可攀的愿望，因而在我深闺待字之年，不管是否门当户对，一味好高，希图将来幸福；

en.t: My parents cherished hopes far beyond our reach, and while I remained unmarried in the inner chambers, they aimed only too high, regardless of whether any match was suitable, dreaming of future happiness for me;

units.source_text: 但倘真成事实，一定反而悲哀，后悔莫及。”

en.t: but if such a thing actually came to pass, it would surely bring sorrow instead, and regret would come too late."

units.source_text: 又想：“我所希望的，只是当他客居此浦期间，互通音信，倒是风流韵事。

en.t: She also thought, "All I hope for is merely to exchange letters with him while he is staying here at this bay; that alone would be a refined romance.

units.source_text: 年来久闻源氏公子大名，常思有缘遥见一面。

en.t: For years I have heard Prince Genji's famous name, and I have often wished that, if fate allowed, I might see him once from afar.

units.source_text: 今因意外之事，来此意外之海滨，我等虽然隔远，亦得隐约拜仰颜色。

en.t: Now, because of an unexpected event, he has come to this unexpected seashore, and although we are far apart, we can still dimly behold his appearance with reverence.

units.source_text: 他那盖世无双的琴声，我等亦得因风听赏。

en.t: We can also listen with delight as the wind carries to us the sound of his peerless koto.

units.source_text: 他那晨夕起居之状，我等亦得确实闻知。

en.t: We can even hear reliably about how he passes his mornings and evenings.

units.source_text: 而像我这样微不足道之人，亦得猥蒙存问。

en.t: And even someone as insignificant as I am has undeservedly received his kind inquiries.

units.source_text: ——但能如此，在我这个厕身渔樵之间而将与草木同朽的人看来，已是莫大之幸福了。”

en.t: If only this much is possible, then to someone like me, living among fishers and woodcutters and destined to decay with the grass and trees, it is already the greatest happiness."

units.source_text: 这样一想，更加觉得自身低微可耻，决不梦想进一步亲近源氏公子了。

en.t: Thinking this way, she felt all the more ashamed of her lowly position and never dreamed of drawing any closer to Prince Genji.
